senses.zh_definition: 迪戈里；英语姓名形式，在《哈利·波特》中用作塞德里克·迪戈里等人物的姓氏。
senses.en_definition: An English personal name, used as the surname of Cedric Diggory and other characters in Harry Potter.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang dalam bahasa Inggeris, termasuk nama keluarga bagi Cedric Diggory dan beberapa watak lain dalam siri Harry Potter.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas。仅凭输入无法确定所指人物；在《哈利·波特》语境中，常须结合 Cedric 或 Amos 等名字判断。不能直接把 Diggory 释为“勇敢”或“巫师”。status 标为 proper_noun，不表示 DBP 官方收词。以下为姓名组合示例，未作语料频率排名。参见 [官方 Cedric Diggory 人物条目](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/cedric-diggory)及[官方相关文章](https://www.harrypotter.com/features/unsung-heroes-of-harry-potter-stories-cedric-diggory)。

dual_scenarios.context: 阅读报告 / 人物分析
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan bacaan ini membincangkan semangat kesukanan Cedric Diggory dalam Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这份阅读报告探讨《哈利·波特与火焰杯》中塞德里克·迪戈里展现的体育精神。
dual_scenarios.en: This reading report discusses Cedric Diggory’s sportsmanship in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku suka Cedric Diggory sebab dia baik dengan Harry walaupun diorang bersaing.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya menyukai Cedric Diggory kerana dia bersikap baik terhadap Harry walaupun mereka bersaing.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我挺喜欢塞德里克·迪戈里的，他跟哈利竞争，却还是对哈利很好。
dual_scenarios.en: I like Cedric Diggory because he’s kind to Harry even though they’re competing.

etymology.historical_story: Diggory is encountered by many modern readers through Cedric Diggory in J. K. Rowling’s Harry Potter stories. The official character account presents him as a Hufflepuff student and Triwizard competitor, making the surname familiar beyond English-speaking audiences. That literary association explains this usage; it does not establish the name’s deeper etymology or any Malay root. [Source: Official Harry Potter Encyclopedia](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/cedric-diggory).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读音近似“迪格里”记住 Diggory，再与 Cedric 连读；这里是姓氏，不是“挖掘”的派生词。
